intent: Copy a code block's text to the clipboard and confirm it.
typical_uses: The copy action of a command or a file excerpt

dont_use_when.situation: Copying text that is not shown in a code block

instead.target: Button, with the application's own clipboard call

invariants.text: A click writes `value` to `navigator.clipboard`, then switches the glyph to a check and the accessible name to `copiedLabel` for two seconds and puts `copiedLabel` once in a polite live region; a refused write changes nothing.
It is a kit Button, ghost and small by default, icon-only, named by `copyLabel` or `copiedLabel`.

anti_patterns.dont: Pass a glyph or a label as children
anti_patterns.do_instead: Leave the glyph to the component and set `copyLabel` and `copiedLabel` for the words

style.states: style accepts a function of the button's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: It is Button's `style`, which Base UI widens to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)`; the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted.

unexposed_parts.reason: code-block.tsx renders it beside the button for the copy announcement; its text is `copiedLabel`, and it is not exported as a component of its own.

bad.title: The value left out
bad.why: The button copies `value`, not the text it sits next to; without it tsc refuses the call.

style.description: TS: CSSProperties | ((state: ButtonState) => CSSProperties | undefined) | undefined. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. style accepts a function of the button's state as well as a plain style object. It is Button's `style`, which Base UI widens to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)`; the compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted.
